text: But topping Pops: His to have been perfect in its kind; yet it is a _translation_ filly, which differs as much from an _origini_, as the moon from the fun.

parsed.faithful: But fuppofing Pope's Iliad to have been perfect in its kind; yet it is a translation filly; which differs as much from an original, as the moon from the fun.
parsed.modern: But supposing Pope's Iliad to have been perfect in its kind; yet it is a translation filly; which differs as much from an original, as the moon from the sun.
